title: Pegasus Low Poly 3D Mount Challenge 2026 – Looking for Feedback and Participants
author: Acceptable-Goose5144
selftext:
Hi everyone,

We've launched a low-poly Pegasus mount challenge for 3D artists and game asset creators.

The goal is to create a stylized, game-ready Pegasus mount while keeping the asset optimized for real-time applications.

There are prizes for the winners and an opportunity to showcase your work to a broader audience.

I'd love to get feedback from the Blender community and see what kind of approaches artists would take for this challenge.

Contest details:  
https://timeandreckoning.com/contests/pegasus-low-poly-3d-mount-2026

Any feedback, suggestions, or participation would be greatly appreciated.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
